scenes.narration: Both masks belong to the same real image from the Apply Cellpose tutorial. One is its saved batch output; the other is its saved live-preview output. They use the same model with different preprocessing, not two competing sets of weights. Neither mask is ground truth.
speech_text: Both masks belong to the same real image from the Apply [Cellpose](/sˈɛlpˌOz/) tutorial.
One is its saved batch output; the other is its saved live-preview output.
They use the same model with different pre-processing, not two competing sets of weights.
Neither mask is ground truth.
